baseline_models.mechanism: Leaning transfers bodily weight to settled supports, while straight rows turn private ease into an intentionally ordered collective posture.

activation_trace.role: Leaning on a support supplies the bodily dependence that makes repose possible.
A settled couch or seat supplies stable support and locates ease materially.
Arrangement in a straight row converts separate couches into one coordinated social field.

changed_reading.after: The verse stages bodily release inside a deliberately aligned assembly: support is shared and repose is ordered.

baseline_models.mechanism: An external agent joins counterparts, and the two following descriptors intensify an embodied ocular encounter through contrast and breadth of eye.

activation_trace.role: Pairing or joining makes the relation an enacted connection rather than a nearby inventory item.
Contrasting white and black in the eye supplies the first visual specification of the companions.
Wide beautiful eyes intensify the companions' visible and embodied presence.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful companions are added to a reward scene.
changed_reading.after: The beneficiaries are actively joined into companionship, with ocular contrast and breadth making the encounter concrete rather than generic.

baseline_models.mechanism: Rows coordinate plural occupants, while pairing can join peers and عين can denote present persons or exact selves; together these branches keep the companions socially individuated.

activation_trace.role: The straight row supplies a plural arrangement in which distinct positions remain visible.
Peers or associates make pairing a relation among counterparts, not only a possession relation.
The eye as people present lets the final word resonate with co-present personhood.
The thing itself contributes exact identity, resisting absorption of persons into a decorative class.

changed_reading.before: The second half depicts a private couple as part of individual luxury.
changed_reading.after: It can also depict matched peers entering an ordered gathering as present, distinct persons.

baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside its ocular branch, حور retains distant but live branches of changed state and returned speech; joining under direct sight can therefore carry an undertone of reciprocal transformation and response.

activation_trace.role: Turning back or changing state supplies a latent reversal inside the companion descriptor.
Speech turned back and forth supplies reciprocity rather than mute display.
Joining provides the relation within which reversal and reply can operate.
Face-to-face seeing gives the proposed reciprocity a perceptual setting.

changed_reading.before: حور is exhausted by a visual class label.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing the ocular sense, it can carry a low-confidence undertone of companions who answer, turn toward, and participate in changed relation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The couch root also carries inward secrecy and concealed marital relation, so the public geometry of rows can coexist with a protected interior of intimacy.

activation_trace.role: Keeping something hidden inwardly contributes an interior dimension beneath the overt couch sense.
A veiled marital relation links the couch root's hidden interior to the explicit pairing construction.
The spouse branch supplies the intimate relationship that the secrecy branches can protect.
The visible straight row creates the counterpressure of communal exposure.

changed_reading.before: Rows make the scene wholly public, while pairing is merely added to it.
changed_reading.after: The focus alone permits a tension between communal order and an inward, protected marital sphere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening joins units into a book and places them in a written row; the rowed couches later render that compositional order as a human assembly.

activation_trace.role: Straight arrangement supplies the focus verse's aligned social units.
Joining one thing to another supplies composition from discrete units.
The aligned written row provides a formal analogue for the aligned couches.

structural_cues: 52:2 juxtaposes a book with something line-inscribed; 52:20 later marks the couches as line-arranged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies composition, a written row, and a straight furniture row; I infer a formal arrow from inscription to social arrangement, while the live alternative is an accidental visual echo with no semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: The rows merely describe furniture placement.
changed_reading.after: The rows make the rewarded assembly resemble a composed inscription in which distinct occupants form an intelligible whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky undulation and mountain displacement remove the world's reliable supports; leaning on settled, aligned couches then reads as an eschatological re-stabilization rather than generic leisure.

activation_trace.role: Reliance on a support supplies the bodily answer to prior unsteadiness.
Settled support provides the restored place where weight can safely come to rest.
Straight rows replace large-scale disorder with measured spatial order.
Oscillation and undulation supply the loss of a stable overhead world.
Displacement supplies the removal of mountains from their expected stations.

structural_cues: 52:9-10 dismantles sky and mountain stability before 52:20 supplies leaning, settled support, and straight rows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic oscillation, displacement, support, and alignment; I infer a contrastive arrow from unseating to re-seating, while the alternative is that destruction and reward are adjacent but mechanically independent images.

changed_reading.before: Reclining is a static emblem of comfort.
changed_reading.after: Reclining is the recovered ability to entrust one's weight to a stable world after the old world's supports have moved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed or disputed sight in the punishment sequence gives way to wide-eyed direct presence inside repeated protection and, finally, the eye of watchful care; visibility becomes safe rather than exposing.

activation_trace.role: Wide beautiful eyes retain the focus construction's primary bodily description.
Direct seeing opens a secondary register of unmediated presence.
Physical seeing supplies the earlier accusation of perceptual failure.
Protection that repels harm supplies the safety enabling unguarded repose and encounter.
The eye of watchful care supplies a protective perceptual envelope around the focus scene.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from 'do you not see' at 52:15, through protection at 52:18, to عين in 52:20 and بأعيننا at 52:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sight, bodily eyes, protection, and watchful care; I infer that care makes mutual visibility non-threatening, while the live alternative keeps عين at 52:20 solely as an eye adjective and confines care to 52:48.

changed_reading.before: عين contributes only a beauty trait.
changed_reading.after: Its beauty sense remains, but the scene also becomes one of direct, unafraid presence held within watchful protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins counterparts in ordered positions; the immediately following verse extends joining across generations yet states that each person remains held by individual earning. Relation is restored without erasing identity or responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the relational operation that the next verse broadens beyond a pair.
Rows hold connected occupants in distinct, non-collapsed positions.
Exact identity supplies the person-preserving side of affiliation.
Following supplies generational direction toward those already ahead.
A later party reaching the one ahead supplies reunion across separation.
The individual person supplies the irreducible unit inside restored collectivity.
A held pledge supplies continuing individual accountability within reunion.

structural_cues: 52:21 follows immediately, continues plural pronouns, repeats attachment syntax, and then explicitly says 'each person'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, following, attachment, each person, and pledge; I infer that the focus pairing inaugurates a wider non-absorptive social repair, while the alternative restricts 52:21 to descendants and leaves the focus companions unrelated to that logic.

changed_reading.before: Pairing is an isolated marital reward added to personal luxury.
changed_reading.after: Pairing participates in a wider grammar of restored affiliation whose bonds do not cancel distinct personhood or responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The latent reply branch of حور becomes more active when the rewarded gathering turns face to face, exchanges questions, and begins quoted speech; companionship becomes conversational reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: Turning speech back and forth supplies a latent dialogic capacity in the focus descriptor.
Joining provides the reciprocal relation in which conversation can occur.
Face-to-face seeing supplies embodied mutual attention.
One thing facing another supplies the gathering's interpersonal orientation.
Mutual questioning supplies explicit turn-taking rather than one-way display.
Spoken utterance realizes the reciprocal scene as audible testimony.

structural_cues: 52:25-26 shifts the same reward scene from arrangement and provision to mutual facing, reciprocal questions, and quoted speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reply branch, joining, face-to-face orientation, mutual questioning, and speech; I infer that these cues color the companions as potential interlocutors, while the live alternative limits the later dialogue to the rewarded people and gives حور no dialogic force.

changed_reading.before: The dialogic branch of حور is a focus-only lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The later face-to-face exchange makes reciprocal, speaking companionship a live co-reading beside the ocular one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers recall fear-laced care among their household, then name protection and mercy; the turning branch of حور lets the focus pairing resonate as an affective reversal from vulnerable household attachment to secure relation.

activation_trace.role: Change from one state to another supplies the reversal from anxiety to security.
Joining supplies the new relational state produced after protection.
A group of nearness and belonging supplies the remembered household domain.
Care mixed with fear supplies the household's former affective condition.
Repelling harm supplies the causal release from fear.
Kinship in the mercy root keeps familial belonging active within divine compassion.

structural_cues: 52:25-28 retrospectively narrates the earlier family condition from inside the secure gathering introduced at 52:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household belonging, anxious care, protection, mercy, joining, and change of state; I infer a reversal of relational affect, while the live alternative treats protection as solely escape from punishment and does not connect it to the focus pairing.

changed_reading.before: The companions are an additional reward unrelated to the speakers' prior social fear.
changed_reading.after: The pairing can also mark a repaired mode of belonging: relation remains, but fear no longer saturates care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protected concealment and mutually facing groups resolve the focus tension between inward intimacy and rowed publicity: the assembly can be open to relation without becoming exposed or anonymous.

activation_trace.role: Inward concealment supplies privacy beneath the overt couch sense.
A concealed marital relation connects privacy to the pairing that follows.
Straight rows retain communal openness and ordered co-presence.
A preserving cover supplies an explicit image of protected, not erased, visibility.
A group turning toward one another supplies social openness without undifferentiated exposure.

structural_cues: The rowed and paired scene is followed by protected pearls and then a gathering that turns inward toward mutual conversation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward secrecy, marital concealment, protective covering, rows, and mutual facing; I infer an environment-wide balance of privacy and relation, while the alternative confines مكنون to the servants' simile and reads سرر only as couches.

changed_reading.before: Rows imply display, and privacy would require separation from the gathering.
changed_reading.after: The scene can coordinate protected intimacy with communal presence: concealment is safeguarding, not isolation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the axis branch of حور is remote from the adjective's primary ocular morphology. It remains anchored to حور and مصفوفة and is activated by explicit circling at 52:24; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial resonance, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Fixed straight rows supply the stable geometry of resting positions.
Turning on an axis supplies a latent rotational counter-motion within the focus wording.
Circling around something realizes movement around the fixed assembly.

changed_reading.before: The banquet is a motionless tableau of rows and companions.
changed_reading.after: It can be imagined as a kinetic service geometry: fixed rows hold repose while care circulates around them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because صف as gathering at water and عين as spring are not the primary readings of مصفوفة and عين here. Exact focus roots plus the context's drinking group, replenished flow, and filled cup keep it structurally live; downstream prose should call it a hydrological-social echo, not a lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: Gathering at water turns the row into a possible congregation around shared provision.
A flowing spring supplies the latent source around which fellowship can gather.
A drinking group supplies the social rather than merely consumptive dimension of water.
Water replenished by other water supplies continuity and inexhaustible extension.
The cup together with its contents materializes shared flow in a handled vessel.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an erotic and furniture-centered tableau.
changed_reading.after: A faint co-reading recasts its rows as fellowship organized around abundant, circulating provision.

strongest_changes: Ordered couches became a human-scale re-stabilization after cosmic oscillation and displacement.
Pairing expanded into non-erasing affiliation across peers and generations while preserving individual personhood.
The ocular reading remained primary but gained coexisting registers of safe visibility, watchful care, reversal, and reciprocal speech.
Static banquet imagery acquired dynamic models of circling service and shared flow.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots interlock unusually across support, rows, pairing, turning, dialogue, sight, personhood, secrecy, and water; later context activates these as a social mechanism rather than a catalog of luxuries.
remaining_uncertainties: The morphology of حور عين strongly favors ocular description, so turning, dialogue, axis, person, and spring branches must remain additive resonances rather than substitute translations.
The later speakers are explicitly the rewarded group; extending their face-to-face dialogue to the paired companions is abductive, not syntactically compelled.
The protected-privacy model generalizes from the pearl simile and may be local to the attendants instead.
Nothing in the packet finally decides whether the couch rows encode equality, hierarchy, ceremony, or only visual order.
